title_en: APARTMENT 1+1+2 FOR SALE IN VILLA L!
description_en: Apartment for sale in the area of ​​Astir at Vila L. It is suitable for 1+1 and 2 bathrooms, but it can easily be returned to the original condition of 2+1+2. The apartment is organized in; - living room with shared kitchen, - 1 bedroom, - 2 bathrooms, one of which is in the master bedroom and a spacious balcony. - Offered furnished as in the photo, with contemporary furnishings including suspended ceilings, ground air conditioners, hood system, incaso toilets, appliances of prestigious brands, etc. - The building is equipped with an elevator and regular maintenance. - Ideal for residence or investment. - South-west orientation - Possibility of parking at an extra price.
